title: Selected greenhouse notebook entries
provenance: Fictional copied notes; not live or independently verified.
intent: Help the greenhouse coordinator understand the supplied order of selected notes, not a complete incident record or a procedure for changing equipment.

items.label: 08:05 — Nia recorded a west-bench display reading of 12 degrees Celsius
detail: Attendant Nia recorded the display reading, not an independently checked air temperature.

items.label: Approximately 08:20 — Omar wrote that he closed the west vent
detail: Caretaker Omar's exact closure time and the vent's prior opening width were not supplied. This is a report of an action, not proof of its effect.

items.label: 08:50 — Nia recorded the same west-bench display reading 15 degrees Celsius
detail: No comparison reading from another bench was supplied.

items.label: 09:10 — Eli recorded requesting a sensor check for 7 December, the next day
detail: Coordinator Eli's request does not establish that a check was scheduled, performed or completed.

notes: The notes do not establish why the display reading changed, whether closing the vent caused any change, or whether the sensor was accurate.
They do not establish the current greenhouse temperature or vent position. No target temperature, alarm threshold or instruction to repeat the vent action is supplied.
